answer: Each new identity must lock a bond for 30 days: 50 POA for the first, but 100, 200, then 400 POA for additional accounts that share funding sources, posting timing, or behavior clusters. Like a voyage where each extra sled needs its own team, every fake identity adds locked capital, not free influence. Even a zephyr of duplicated activity is flagged when verifiers cross-check cluster signals across the tundra of transaction history for 8 epochs; proven duplication slashes 25% of all linked bonds, released only after 14 quiet days.
